text: A synthetic RNA hairpin that sequesters the ribosome binding site until a complementary trigger RNA binds and unfolds it, enabling translation of a reporter gene, is called a ___ switch.
explanation: Toehold switches are the RNA-based riboregulator technology used in cell-free paper diagnostics for pathogens such as Zika virus and SARS-CoV-2, producing a visible readout only when the target trigger RNA is present.
